searchText: Looking for input here https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/179 I think swapping to `produceBeaconBlockHeader` is pretty important to enable many MEV designs and reduce the complexity in the VC for any alternativ block proposal cosnructions Personally I'm not in favor of the trusted relay design that's floating around. I'd rather that there was some clear path forward before we start to alter APIs.
